facts.fact: StackAdapt was named on the 2024 Best Workplaces for Women list by Great Place to Work for the second year in a row.
facts.quote: has been named on the [2024 list of Best Workplaces for Women](https://www.greatplacetowork.ca/en/best-workplaces/best-workplaces-for-women-2024) for the second year in a row.

facts.fact: To be eligible for the Best Workplaces for Women list, organizations must be Great Place to Work-Certified and have exceptionally high scores from employees on the Trust Index survey.
facts.quote: To be eligible for this list, organizations must be Great Place to Work- Certified™ and have exceptionally high scores from employees on the Trust Index survey.

facts.fact: The Best Workplaces for Women list is based on direct feedback from employees of hundreds of organizations surveyed by Great Place to Work.
facts.quote: The list is based on direct feedback from employees of the hundreds of organizations that were surveyed by Great Place to Work®.

facts.fact: Great Place to Work's Canadian lists represent the voices of 500,000 employees across industry, according to the firm's own description.
facts.quote: represents the voices of 500,000 employees across industry

facts.fact: StackAdapt is rated the number 1 demand-side platform (DSP) on G2, according to StackAdapt's own press release.
facts.quote: is rated [the number 1 demand-side platform](https://www.stackadapt.com/best-demand-side-platform-dsp) (DSP) on G2

facts.fact: The page title states that StackAdapt was named one of the 2024 Best Workplaces for Women.
